changes.text: 崇厚与俄国定约后，朝议久争不决。左宗棠上奏逐条指出界务、商务两处不可许，给出议论与战阵两步的方案；奏上获嘉许后，他又自请出屯哈密。一份谈砸的协议面前，光说反对不够，还得说清哪几条不能让、以及凭什么再谈。

After Chong Hou concluded a treaty with Russia, the court debated it at length without reaching a decision. Zuo Zongtang's memorial put the objection into items — the border terms and the trade terms, each marked as unacceptable — and set out a two-stage plan of negotiation followed by battle. After the memorial was commended, he volunteered to take command at Hami. Faced with a badly negotiated agreement, opposing it is not enough: you have to say which clauses cannot move, and what stands behind your demand to talk again.
僵局之中，左宗棠上奏，逐条点出哪几处不可许，主张「先之以議論，委婉而用機，次決之以戰陣，堅忍而求勝」。奏上获嘉许，他于是自请出屯哈密。六年四月，他「輿櫬發肅州」，五月抵哈密。明年正月，和议成，交还伊犁。

Into that deadlock stepped Zuo Zongtang with a memorial. Item by item he named the terms that must not be accepted, and argued that one should "first take the matter up in negotiation, tactful and alert to opportunity, then settle it on the field of battle, patient and set on victory." The throne commended it, and he then asked leave to move his headquarters to Hami. In the fourth month of the sixth year he "set out from Suzhou with a coffin in his carriage," and reached Hami in the fifth month. In the first month of the following year, peace was concluded and Ili was returned.
作者推断，这道奏疏的分量来自结构，不只来自立场。它把反对拆成条目——界务一处、商务一处，各自说明为何不可许；把方案写成顺序——先议论、后战阵。朝廷随后命曾纪泽更前约，崇厚得罪去，这一段是有记录的。奏疏获嘉许之后，他又自请出屯哈密，把第二步落到具体的人和地上。

The author's reading is that this memorial carried weight through its structure, not merely its stance. It broke the objection into items — one for the border terms, one for trade, each with its own stated reason for refusal. It wrote the plan as a sequence: negotiation first, battle second. That the court then sent Zeng Jize to revise the earlier treaty, and that Chong Hou was punished and dismissed, is on the record. After the memorial was commended, he volunteered to hold Hami, making the second step concrete — a named man in a named place.
一份采购续约送到手上，里面有随行情调价、有最低采购量。内部有两种声音：一边想整包签下，一边想推倒重来。可用的做法是把条款拆开：哪两条不让、哪几条可以换、拿什么换，一条一条写出来——反对写成条目，才有得谈。

A procurement renewal lands in your hands, with prices that adjust to the market and a minimum purchase commitment inside it. There are two voices internally: one wants to sign the whole package, the other wants to start over. The usable move is to break the clauses apart: which two are not open to concession, which few can be traded, and what you would take in exchange — written out one line at a time. An objection becomes negotiable only when it is itemized.

dispositions.rationale: 原文中朝廷先嘉许奏疏、崇厚得罪、命曾纪泽使俄，「於是」左宗棠才自请出屯哈密。导语中英文都改为奏上获嘉许后再自请出屯哈密，不再写成奏疏本身的内容。

evidence.quote: 上壯其言，嘉許之。崇厚得罪去，命曾紀澤使俄，更前約
於是宗棠乃自請出屯哈密

dispositions.rationale: 把自请出屯哈密从上奏动作中拆出，改为奏上获嘉许之后的单独一步，中英同步。ev 补入 E11、E12 以支撑新增的时序表述。

evidence.quote: 於是宗棠乃自請出屯哈密

dispositions.rationale: 奏疏的结构只保留拆条目、排顺序两点。自请出屯哈密移到朝廷嘉许、崇厚得罪的记录之后，明确写成奏疏获嘉许之后的行动，不再作为奏疏有说服力的原因。ev 补入 E12，中英同步。

dispositions.rationale: 「堅忍而求勝」逐字出自 E10，但该段 ev 未引用 E10。现将 E10 加入 analysis.1 的 ev，正文不改。

dispositions.rationale: today.0 的开头与反思情境用语重复，已改写为“送到手上”“内部有两种声音”等不同表述，去掉「摆在桌上」「有人主张……全部推翻」等重合词组。条款拆分的建议不变，中英同步。
